_instructions: Source of truth for the build. DO NOT delete, edit, or renumber existing ids/titles. Statuses: passing (done+proven), failing (actionable), deferred (postponed; notes say when actionable), superseded (dead, kept for history). Flip failing->passing only when a test or the stated manual check proves it. Append new features with the next id in their milestone. Work ONE feature per session: lowest milestone, then lowest id, among 'failing'.

milestones.51: Upgrade re-checks open plans; board shows every field
milestones.52: Onboarding installs what its docs reference

features.title: Release README coverage: every CHANGELOG release from 3.17.0 names the README phrases that document it (or README: none (reason)), checked by scripts/check-readme.sh in the gate; HARNESS_TEMPLATE_DIR runs the template sync check
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-check-readme.sh proving a covered release passes, and a missing README: line, a line without phrases, none without a reason, a phrase absent from README.md and 3.17.10 (numeric compare) all fail; this repo's CHANGELOG/README pass; bash scripts/ci-local.sh prints CI-LOCAL GREEN

features.title: Upgrade re-checks open plans against the current protocol: upgrade.sh names each failing feature missing depends_on or paths, and a chain where each open feature depends only on the previous one as 'depends_on may be order only'; the upgrade skill proposes fixes for approval
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-upgrade.sh proving the lanes TODO names the open feature without paths, the order-only TODO names the chain, and a passing feature is never named

features.title: Board rows show every FEATURES.json field ('All fields', open state kept across reloads) and a queued row's agent column shows its planned model and effort; a deferred feature shows 'deferred', not 'queued'
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-board.sh proving a row lists exclusive, evaluate, bar, depends_on, paths and an escaped verify under All fields, and a queued row shows 'model large · effort high', and a deferred feature's row has stage deferred

features.title: Run state is never committed: setup and upgrade add .harness-run/ to .gitignore (the runs protocol already claimed it was listed), quiet.sh ignores its own log folder in a repo that lacks the entry, and the audit warns when .harness-run/ is not ignored
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-upgrade.sh proving upgrade.sh adds .harness-run/ once (CHANGED, then OK) and keeps a last .gitignore line without a newline whole, test-session.sh proving quiet.sh leaves git status clean in a repo without the entry and writes no .gitignore where the repo ignores it, and test-audit.sh proving the WARN

features.title: Onboarded docs name only files that exist where they say: kit scripts and templates (quiet.sh, context.sh, run-gate.sh, feature.sh, status.sh, *.tmpl) are called kit files with their kit location and a plugin-less fallback, and scripts/check-doc-refs.sh fails the gate when a protocol doc or AGENTS.md.tmpl names a file neither installed by setup nor shipped by the kit, or names kit files without saying so
features.verify: bash scripts/e2e.sh exits 0 with test-check-doc-refs.sh proving the kit is clean and each of: an unknown script, a kit script or template without the location note, an uninstalled scripts/*.sh (unless called optional), and a .gitignore claim without setup or upgrade adding .harness-run/ makes check-doc-refs.sh exit 1
